evidence: The reactant source material for zirconium was commercial Cp2ZrCl2 (Strem Chemicals, #93-4002, 99%) and it was used without purification while In(thd)3 (thd ¼ 2,2,6,6-tetramethylheptane-3,5-dionate) was synthesized according to the procedure established by Eisentraut and Sievers for Y(thd)3. Ozone generated from oxygen gas (99.999%) in an ozone generator (Fischer model 502) was used as the oxidizing reactant. Nitrogen (>99.999%, Schmidlin UHPN 3000 N2 generator) was used as the carrier and purging gas.
